upstream.name: Re reinsurance book
upstream.note: The product itself; concentration here is the design, not a defect. ⚠️ Off-chain reinsurance trusts and counterparties are NOT independently measurable from Ethereum state.

upstream.name: Ethena sUSDe (collateral layer)
upstream.metric: 93.87% of issuer-reported COMBINED protocol reserves, and the Ethereum redemption payout asset
upstream.note: ⚠️ The percentage is COMBINED reUSD + reUSDe and must NOT be read as a reUSD-only allocation. Imports Ethena risk into a reinsurance product — a dependency a reader would not expect from the category.

dependencies.note: ⚠️ DELIBERATE REDUCTION, not a loss. Two entries by design. The NAV oracle write path was carried here and has been removed: it is the issuer's OWN CONTROL SURFACE, not an external counterparty whose failure propagates in, and mixing the two kinds makes 'dependency' ambiguous on the axis a reader reaches looking for counterparties. It is rendered on AXIS 1, beside the NAV the discount is measured against, and on AXIS 5, in the authority walk beside the undelayed mint path. These entries are riskAnalyst-authored and CARRY PegTracker's measured figures rather than replacing them — a per-field array swap would otherwise drop the sUSDe measurement off the axis a reader checks for dependencies.
dependencies.upstream_resolution_rule: ⚠️ EVERY upstream entry MUST carry exactly one resolution: `slug` (one asset we score), `slugs` (a set entry naming several), `terminal: true` + `kind` (never scoreable — oracle, venue, contract, authority, incentive, real-world), or `unresolved` (scoreable, no report yet = COVERAGE GAP). ⚠️ TERMINAL AND UNRESOLVED ARE DIFFERENT CLAIMS and must never be merged: terminal means nothing is missing, unresolved means a report is owed. `address` is REQUIRED wherever the ticker collides in this corpus (DUSD x4, msUSD x3, reUSD x2, USD3 x2, BOLD x2) — a ticker-keyed graph would merge Resupply's reUSD (3.5) with Re Protocol's (5.0).

downstream_basis.asserted_only_note: None — every asserted edge is reproducible from an upstream array.
downstream_basis.do_not_hand_edit: ⚠️ downstream_tracked is GENERATED. Hand-maintaining both directions is how fxsave came to list fxUSD as BOTH its upstream and its downstream — one edge recorded twice, in opposite directions. Add the edge to the UPSTREAM array of the dependent asset and re-run build.
